# `MC_knlFree`

Release a WIPI-managed allocation identified by a memory ID.

## Prototype

```c
void MC_knlFree(M_Uint32 mID);
```

```{doxygenfunction} MC_knlFree
:project: libwipi
```

## Usage

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `mID` | Memory ID previously returned by MC_knlAlloc or MC_knlCalloc. |

### Ownership

The memory ID and every pointer resolved from it become invalid after this call.
